mapper.insert: insert into te_score (class_id, group_id, user_id, group_score, final_score, is_published, publish_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{classId}, #{groupId}, #{userId}, #{groupScore}, #{finalScore}, 0, null, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}) on duplicate key update class_id = #{classId}, group_id = #{groupId}, group_score = #{groupScore}, final_score = #{finalScore}, is_published = 0, publish_time = null, update_time = #{updateTime}
mapper.select: select s.id, s.class_id, s.group_id, s.user_id, s.group_score, s.final_score, s.is_published, s.publish_time, s.create_time, s.update_time, u.nick_name, st.student_no, g.group_name from te_score s left join sys_user u on u.user_id = s.user_id left join te_student st on st.user_id = s.user_id left join te_group g on g.id = s.group_id where s.group_id = #{groupId} order by st.student_no
select id, class_id, group_id, user_id, group_score, final_score, is_published, publish_time, create_time, update_time from te_score where user_id = #{userId} limit 1
